description:
This Pigmentation Repair Cream targets dark patches and rough skin in body folds like the neck, knees, elbows, underarms, and thighs.

A targeted, science-backed cream designed to reduce body-fold pigmentation in one simple step with this advanced formula built for pigmentation  around the neck, knees, elbows, and thighs.

✨ Why You’ll Love It? 
✅ Powered by Actives – Kojic Acid, Lactic Acid & Retinol work together to exfoliate, renew skin, and reduce melanin formation.
✅ Texture Refining – 2% Urea softens hard, thick skin caused by friction or dryness.
✅ Dermat-Tested – Visible improvement in pigmentation and smoothness within weeks. 

Reduce Pigmentation & Restore Smoothness in one cream!

Step 1: Cleanse the affected area and pat dry.
Step 2: Apply pea-sized cream onto the skin.

faqs.question: When should I apply this cream?
faqs.answer: Since this is a leave-in formulation, you can apply the cream on the pigmented areas post your shower in the morning. Keep it as long as possible and wait for the cream to absorb.

faqs.question: How much time will it take to see results?
faqs.answer: You should notice visible reduction in pigmentation with 3 months of use. For severe pigmentation: changes depend on the severity of the condition. We recommend speaking to an expert for your specific case.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Yes, both products are Paraben, Sulphate & Phthalate-free. However, do a patch test before first use and introduce gradually if you have sensitive skin.

faqs.question: Can I use this product on my face?
faqs.answer: This product is formulated for use on the body and may be too potent for the delicate skin on your face. We recommend using products specifically designed for facial moisturization.

faqs.question: How does Lactic Acid help in pigmentation?
faqs.answer: By exfoliating and boosting cell turnover, Lactic Acid helps fade surface-level pigmentation. It gradually reveals smoother, more uniform-toned skin.
